name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 26 – Am 16
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 26a. Stresses that EU migration and asylum policy must be underpinned by strong action against illegal migration and that adequate funding to combat illegal migration and violations of the EU’s external borders remains essential to addressing evolving challenges; calls for EU funds to be allocated as a priority to strengthening return and repatriation measures and securing the EU’s external borders, including by constructing and reinforcing physical barriers, in order to ensure more effective, coherent and consistent management of migration-related challenges;
